# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Hi, I’m Yusuf Li. I need help with an order change.

I have an order that’s currently set to go to my LA address, but I want it changed to my NYC address instead. I’d really rather not read the NYC address out loud if possible — I believe it should already be on another one of my orders, so I’m hoping you can use that one.

Also, I want to exchange the Bluetooth Speaker on the order for the cheapest green version you have.

I’m a little worried about messing anything up, so if you need to verify me, my zip code is 91148. I don’t remember which email address I used, unfortunately.
